title.zh: 【Coinbase 拟扩大传统金融机构服务，主经纪业务增长迅速】
title.en: 【Coinbase 拟扩大传统金融机构服务，主经纪业务增长迅速】

current_state.zh: Coinbase is expanding services for traditional financial firms, citing rapid prime-brokerage growth, and will custody USDC balances in Samsung Wallet, with USDC set to become the default dollar stablecoin for Samsung's payment users in the US by month-end.
current_state.en: Coinbase is expanding services for traditional financial firms, citing rapid prime-brokerage growth, and will custody USDC balances in Samsung Wallet, with USDC set to become the default dollar stablecoin for Samsung's payment users in the US by month-end.
